## What changes?

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Chinese or English is welcome.

## Validation

List relevant commands and results. Include screenshots/GIFs for UI changes, or a reproducible card example for a rules change.

- [ ] `npm test`

## Notes

Mention relevant limitations or third-party asset sources, if any. Do not attach real keys, session data or private request logs.
